what.text: This page follows refugees from Yemen living in Djibouti, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3932 Yemeni refugees in Djibouti, 6.9% of all refugees from Yemen.
Somalia hosts the most Yemeni refugees, followed by the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Yemen in every year from 2008 to 2025, with Ansarallah and AQAP among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Yemen in 2015, 2017 and 2020.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 6232, at the end of 2021; the main years of displacement in the data are 2015 to 2021 and 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Djibouti.
These are year-end totals for Djibouti only, reported to UNHCR.
